description: This file implements core functions related to notifying, negotiating, and establishing network connections in the Git protocol. It handles protocol version detection, capabilities exchange, ref retrieval, and connection setup via various protocols including SSH, file, and Git-native transports.

methods.name: int check_ref(const char * name,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Checks if a ref name matches specified flags, filtering for refs like heads or tags.

methods.name: int check_ref_type(const struct ref * ref,int flags)
methods.description: Checks if a ref matches certain flags by delegating to check_ref.

methods.name: NORETURN void die_initial_contact(int unexpected)
methods.description: Handles unexpected socket hang-ups or read failures during initial contact with remote repository.

methods.name: int server_supports_v2(const char * c)
methods.description: Determines if the server capabilities include support for a specific capability 'c'.

methods.name: void ensure_server_supports_v2(const char * c)
methods.description: Exits with an error if the server does not support a specified capability.

methods.name: int server_feature_v2(const char * c,const char ** v)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a server feature 'c' if supported.

methods.name: int server_supports_feature(const char * c,const char * feature,int die_on_error)
methods.description: Checks if the server supports a specific feature with optional support verification.

methods.name: void process_capabilities_v2(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Reads server capabilities into server_capabilities_v2 vector.

methods.name: enum:protocol_version discover_version(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Detects the protocol version supported by the server based on its initial response.

methods.name: void parse_one_symref_info(struct string_list * symref,const char * val,int len)
methods.description: Parses symref info lines from server response and adds to a string list.

methods.name: void annotate_refs_with_symref_info(struct ref * ref)
methods.description: Annotates each ref with symref target info if available from server features.

methods.name: void process_capabilities(struct packet_reader * reader,size_t * linelen)
methods.description: Processes and stores server capabilities from a server response line.

methods.name: int process_dummy_ref(const struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Checks for a dummy ref that indicates capabilities or other server info.

methods.name: void check_no_capabilities(const char * line,size_t len)
methods.description: Warns if capabilities data appears after the first line.

methods.name: int process_ref(const struct packet_reader * reader,size_t len,struct ref *** list,unsigned int flags,struct oid_array * extra_have)
methods.description: Processes a single ref line, adding it to the ref list if valid.

methods.name: int process_shallow(const struct packet_reader * reader,size_t len,struct oid_array * shallow_points)
methods.description: Processes a shallow commit line.

methods.name: struct:ref ** get_remote_heads(struct packet_reader * reader,struct ref ** list,unsigned int flags,struct oid_array * extra_have,struct oid_array * shallow_points)
methods.description: Reads all refs and shallow info from the server response into a ref list.

methods.name: int process_ref_v2(struct packet_reader * reader,struct ref *** list,const char ** unborn_head_target)
methods.description: Processes a v2 formatted ref line, building the ref list accordingly.

methods.name: void check_stateless_delimiter(int stateless_rpc,struct packet_reader * reader,const char * error)
methods.description: Checks for protocol delimiter in stateless mode.

methods.name: void send_capabilities(int fd_out,struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Sends capabilities to server over the connection.

methods.name: int get_remote_bundle_uri(int fd_out,struct packet_reader * reader,struct bundle_list * bundles,int stateless_rpc)
methods.description: Requests a bundle URI from the server, processes response lines.

methods.name: struct:ref ** get_remote_refs(int fd_out,struct packet_reader * reader,struct ref ** list,int for_push,struct transport_ls_refs_options * transport_options,const struct string_list * server_options,int stateless_rpc)
methods.description: Queries server for refs, returns list of refs.

methods.name: const char * parse_feature_value(const char * feature_list,const char * feature,size_t * lenp,size_t * offset)
methods.description: Parses a feature value string for a specific feature.

methods.name: int server_supports_hash(const char * desired,int * feature_supported)
methods.description: Checks if server object format supports a desired hash algorithm.

methods.name: int parse_feature_request(const char * feature_list,const char * feature)
methods.description: Checks if a server feature request string includes a specific feature.

methods.name: const char * next_server_feature_value(const char * feature,size_t * len,size_t * offset)
methods.description: Retrieves the next server feature value for a given feature name.

methods.name: const char * server_feature_value(const char * feature,size_t * len)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a server feature by name.

methods.name: int server_supports(const char * feature)
methods.description: Checks support for a feature based on server_feature_value.

methods.name: const char * prot_name(enum protocol protocol)
methods.description: Returns a string name for an enumerated protocol.

methods.name: enum:protocol get_protocol(const char * name)
methods.description: Returns a protocol enum from a protocol name string.

methods.name: char * host_end(char ** hoststart,int removebrackets)
methods.description: Finds the end of the host part in a URL or hostname string, handling brackets.

methods.name: void get_host_and_port(char ** host,const char ** port)
methods.description: Extracts host and port from a URL or hostname string.

methods.name: void enable_keepalive(int sockfd)
methods.description: Sets TCP keepalive option on a socket.

methods.name: int git_tcp_connect_sock(char * host,int flags)
methods.description: Creates a TCP connection socket to a host, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: enum:protocol parse_connect_url(const char * url_orig,char ** ret_host,char ** ret_path)
methods.description: Parses a connection URL into protocol, host, and path components.

methods.name: struct:child_process * git_connect_git(int fd[2],char * hostandport,const char * path,const char * prog,enum protocol_version version,int flags)
methods.description: Establishes a git protocol connection over SSH, file, or native protocol.

methods.name: struct:child_process * git_connect(int fd[2],const char * url,const char * name,const char * prog,int flags)
methods.description: Main entry point to establish a connection, handling protocol, transport, and URL parsing.

methods.name: int finish_connect(struct child_process * conn)
methods.description: Finalizes a connection by waiting for child process and cleaning up.
